newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian prime minister to visit the Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian prime minister to visit the Netherlands.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad will make an official visit to the Netherlands on December 4 and 5 at the invitation of the Dutch government, the national Bernama news agency said on Thursday.
Quoting a government statement, Bernama said Mahathir was reciprocating a visit to Malaysia in 1988 by Ruud Lubbers, the Dutch prime minister at the time.
During his visit, Mahathir is to hold talks with his counterpart, Wim Kok, and have an audience with Queen Beatrix.
He is also scheduled to visit Rotterdam port, Arena Stadium, the headquarters of engineering firm Fokker Space, and the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research.
Mahathir will be accompanied by his wife, Siti Hasmah Mohd Ali, some Cabinet ministers and senior government officials.

The statement also said Mahathir would be in the Netherlands a day before his official visit programme begins to deliver a keynote address at the Global Panel Conference, which this year will focus on Malaysia.
